task.title: Recording an animal intake
task.shortdesc: Create a record for an animal that's arriving at your shelter, whether it's a stray, an owner surrender or a transfer.

prereq.p: Scan the animal for a microchip before you start. checks the number against your records and the national registry.

chrow.chdesc: The animal was found. Record where and by whom. A stray hold starts automatically.
An owner is giving up the animal. Collect their contact details and reason for surrender.
The animal comes from a partner organization. Select the partner from the list.
A previously adopted animal is coming back. Search for the existing record instead of creating a new one.

step.cmd: Enter the microchip number, or select No chip found.

stepresult.p: If the chip matches an existing record, offers to open it.

step.cmd: Fill in the animal's name, species, breed, sex, estimated age, weight and coat color.

info.p: If the animal has no name, leave the field blank; assigns a temporary one, like "Intake 0412", that you can change later.

result.p: The new record opens with status Intake and a permanent animal ID. Next, assign the animal to a kennel.
